Synopsis:
Estra Stir is a gossip columnist for the Baldurs Mouth. She has a devilish artifact, the Eye ofTitivilus,  that allows her to detect the thoghts of the people she is talking too. She wants to pump the players for juicy personal details to print in her gossip column.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_BaldursMouth_Estra_DefaultDialog.json: Estra Stir is a Baldur’s Mouth gossip columnist who carries the devilish Eye of Titivilus — a trinket that lets her pull at and detect the surface thoughts of whoever she’s talking to. She’s conducting an interview with the player and is explicitly fishing for juicy, scandalous details to print (offering up “the real story” behind Lord Enver Gortash’s death as bait), and the eye means she may already know or sense parts of the player’s reactions. Off‑screen, the player’s recent tampering with a nearby windmill has just flung a small gnome and drawn goblin scouts (Fezzerk and crew) to investigate, so the exchange happens amid a minor commotion and potential spectators. Depending on the scene, the player might also be holding the Moonlantern (a trapped pixie) or be near Flaming Fist guards, all of which Estra can exploit for more copy.
- LOW_BaldursMouth_Ettvard_DefaultDialog.json: Ettvard Needle is the editor of the Baldur's Mouth Gazette. He is proudly pro-Gortash, obnoxious towards the PC, and insinuates (wel, directly states at the moment)  that the gazette is about to print a hit piece about the players.Players can intimidate Ettvard for some info, or use blackmail on him if they have found it to keep the hit piece from being published.
- LOW_BaldursMouth_AD_EstraAndPaperBoy.json: AD conversation between Estra Stirr and a Baldurs Mouth paper seller across from the Stormshore Tabernacle in Lower City.
- LOW_Elfsong_Patron004.json: Patron Thimble, dialogue at Elfsong Tavern. Speaks about Gortash' propaganda.
- LOW_BaldursMouth_MalekStones.json: Malek Stones is a paranoic investigative journalist for the Baldurs Mouth. Short dialog to add a little extra life to the office and make it seem busy. If Ettvard Needle is dead, Malek briefly explains he is promoted up to the new head of the paper.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Estra Stir: I can tell an inquisitive sort when I see one - want the real story behind the untimely demise of Lord Enver Gortash? || [context] NodeContext: conducting an interview (node 44)
- Player: I'd rather never hear that prick's name again, thanks. (node 57)
